SCHEDULE: {"1":"Hana","2":"Finn","3":"Cara","4":"Ben","5":"Ann","6":"Gus","7":"Elif","8":"Ivo","9":"Dev"}
CONFIDENCE: 90

I rechecked all 20 constraints against this order and each one holds. I did not re-verify that no other schedule works, so the confidence reflects that.

The team note is wrong. With Hana in slot 1 and Finn in slot 2, Cara in slot 4 would have two people between her and Hana (Finn and the person in slot 3). "Exactly one person between Cara and Hana" puts Cara in slot 3, which is what this schedule uses.
